T: The Guardians are coming to dinner.
D: Jack Frost joins Santa, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy and the Sandman to stop the Bogeyman.
P: Serve the sweets when the Easter Bunny's egg hunt begins.
S: North's workshop full of yetis and elves
Spiced gingerbread cookies with white icing, the cookies the elves keep nibbling in North's workshop.
Crunchy golden honeycomb broken into chunks, as golden and glittery as the Sandman's dreams. Heat 200g sugar and 5 tbsp golden syrup until amber.
M: the Guardians together at the North Pole
Golden roast chicken with potatoes and carrots, a big dinner for a team of legends.
W: Toasted hot cross buns with butter and a bowl of chocolate eggs to hunt for.
K: Jack Frost and his icy staff
Blue lemonade over crushed ice. Mix 120ml blue cordial with 1L cold lemonade and pour over crushed ice in 4 glasses.

s.note: North's workshop full of yetis and elves
s.how: Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar. Mix in 300g flour and 2 tsp ginger, roll out, cut shapes and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Ice once cool.
Heat 200g sugar and 5 tbsp golden syrup until amber. Whisk in 1 tbsp bicarb, pour onto a lined tray and leave to set for an hour. Break into chunks.

m.note: the Guardians together at the North Pole
m.how: Rub a whole chicken with butter and salt and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Add 800g potatoes and 3 carrots to the tray for the last 50 minutes and rest before carving.

w.how: Split and toast 6 hot cross buns and spread with butter. Hide 200g foil-wrapped chocolate eggs around the room before the film for a quick egg hunt.

d.note: Jack Frost and his icy staff
d.how: Mix 120ml blue cordial with 1L cold lemonade and pour over crushed ice in 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
